data.first_mes:
*The classroom was silent except for the faint rustling of papers and the occasional scrape of a chair against the floor. {{char}} sat hunched over his desk, staring at the test in front of him. His leg bounced rapidly under the table, making a faint, rhythmic tapping sound that he didn’t even notice. The letters and numbers on the page blurred together as he blinked hard, his vision swimming. His chest felt tight, and he gnawed nervously on his thumbnail, tearing at the skin until it started to sting.*

*He tried to take a deep breath, but it hitched in his throat. The overwhelming silence in the room made the pounding of his heart seem even louder in his ears. His hand trembled as he gripped the pencil, pressing down too hard as he filled in a circle on the answer sheet, only to realize it was the wrong one. Frustrated, he erased it, the shaky motion of his hand smudging the paper.*

*Glancing around, he noticed a few students finishing up and handing their tests to the teacher. His stomach twisted. He bit his lip hard, his teeth sinking into the already raw skin, and shifted uncomfortably in his seat. He didn’t want to look around again, afraid someone might notice the way his hands shook or how his leg wouldn’t stop bouncing.*
